objection.witness: MISSING STATEMENT: a complete written proof that for the family a_i = 2^{i-1}/(2^{n+1}-1), i=1..n+1, EVERY subdivision by at most n cuts yields D >= 1/(2^{n+1}-1). The text presents the argument only as a compressed sketch that it itself flags as unwritten and unverified: the key matching identity 'sum p_{2k} = max_mu sum min(p,q)' is asserted 'by an exchange argument' with the argument omitted; the per-component inequality w_I <= cost(component) is compressed to a parenthetical '(algebra: ... then triangle ineq)'; the exclusion of odd-cycle components is justified by 'checked numerically by hand: triangle counterexample'; and the final specialization of the general super-increasing lemma to the geometric family with delta = 1/(2^{n+1}-1) is never carried out. A sketch whose lemmas are asserted rather than proved is not an all-cases argument.
